• Agreed on project timeline and key milestones
• Reviewed initial design concepts and gathered client feedback

Action items:
• Emma to update project plan based on client feedback
• David to coordinate with development team to start initial phase

The next meeting is scheduled for June 1, 2024.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
